column3: “A portion of his income” specifies what is set aside according to his prosperity.
The Greek describes sending the approved people with letters; BSB describes sending letters with them.
The final clause has present “I am going through,” rather than “I will be going through.”
The conjunction and is made concessive as “even though”; effective qualifies the door, expanded as “for effective work.”
“Of courage” interprets the instruction to act as men.
The Greek says to let all their things take place in love; BSB makes this a direct command to do everything in love.
“First converts” renders firstfruit; the exhortation is moved to the end of the verse.
“Show your appreciation” renders recognize or acknowledge.
“Province” specifies Asia; the church's greeting is expressed as a separate clause rather than with Aquila and Prisca.
“Come, O Lord!” renders the transcribed expression “Marana tha.”
BSB’s “Amen” matches the Textus Receptus (ἀμήν); the critical text lacks it.
